about_the_game:
Secret of Dawnstone is an action adventure that takes you into an open world inspired by the Alps. Between snow-covered peaks, mysterious forests, and ancient mountain huts, you will explore a village full of riddles and legends.

Over the course of your journey, you will experience changing seasons – from bright summer to deep winter. Each season transforms the world, opens new paths, brings unique dangers, and even alters the enemies you encounter. But beware: defeated foes stay dead – until the seasons turn or a new chapter of your story begins.

On your adventure you will face Alpine folklore creatures such as the Perchten, the Kasamandl, or the legendary Zlatorog. With every encounter, you come closer to uncovering the mysteries of the village and the mythical “Dawnstone.”

Features

  • Alpine Open World: Explore a handcrafted pixel world inspired by the Alps.

  • Changing Seasons: Summer, autumn, winter, and spring change the world, enemies, and quests.

  • Folklore Creatures: Confront Perchten, gnomes, mountain spirits, and other mythical beings.

  • Defeated enemies: Defeated enemies stay dead – until new seasons begin.

  • Mysterious Village: Meet quirky villagers and discover quests.

  • Atmospheric Music: Enjoy a soundscape inspired by Alpine instruments and traditions mixed with retro video game music.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and above
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard & Mouse, Controller supported
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560 (or better)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended for the best experience
